<quote by="Proposed: Casinea, Seconded: Bastion">To raise a fourth Highborn army in Casinea</quote>
==Overview==
* Raises an [[Army]] in Casinea
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[The_war_of_thorns_and_flowers#Highguard|The war of thorns and flowers]]''' wind of fortune
* The cost has been reduced by each of the Generals of Highguard receiving an artefact, hallowed banner as [[387YE_Spring_Equinox_Senate_sessions#Assign_Regalia_to_Generals_of_Highguard|regalia]]
* The general of the new army will have the artefact, hallowed banner, ''Ever Forward'', as regalia
==Date==
* Spring 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 80 mithril (reduced from 200 mithril)
* 240 crowns (reduced from 600 crowns)
* Six months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Raise_Fourth_Highborn_Army}}
==Outcome==
* Now completed, the [[Pilgrim's Defiance|General of the Pilgrim's Defiance]] will be available for election by unanimous decision of the Highborn senators for the first time at the Autumn Equinox 387YE for a shortened term of one season
